job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, test, and deploy AI models using Python and other relevant technologies.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify business problems that can be solved through the application of AI techniques.
Develop data pipelines to collect, process, and analyze large datasets for training and testing AI models.
Ensure high-quality deliverables by conducting thorough testing and debugging of AI systems.

Job Requirements :

9-14 years of experience in developing AI solutions using Python or similar programming languages.
Strong understanding of machine learning algorithms, deep learning concepts, and neural networks.
Experience working with cloud-based platforms such as AWS or Azure is an added advantage.
